scope: Teacher receives English reference. Conditional-generation diagnostic only; not fair benchmark accuracy, not training-label synthesis, and not an evaluation of all on-policy teacher-token distributions.
interpretation: Original frozen1.7B can exploit supplied English problem/reference on this BN dev set. This rules out a blanket claim that privileged context offers no usable conditional signal; it does not isolate the cause of trained BN collapse or establish useful teacher distributions at every student trajectory position. Teacher answers are not SFT labels.
comparison_boundary: Student control uses official training-collator prefix. Its6/100 is separate from the standard dev-evaluator Base8/100; do not mix these prompt protocols.
